name: anchor: register on assign & organization role scope
description: anchor#312: the resource member PUT with a `resource` block registers a document, then renames and moves it, and sets the role in one call; refusals write nothing (409 PARENT_NOT_REGISTERED, 400 ROLE_SCOPE_MISMATCH, 403 without resource:write while the same key still assigns); without the block an unregistered resource is 404. anchor#311: member add, member role update, invitation create and update and a founding member refuse a project-scoped role with 400 ROLE_NOT_ORGANIZATION_SCOPED (role_id, resource_type metadata) and keep the current role. Own product, deleted always. Generator: echopoint-investigation/gen_register_assign.py.
